command: npm run test:drive-live (office-primary) + the same drive-harness binary with the second installation's own stored grant (office-secondary)
environment: Two physical Windows installations, each with its own stored production OAuth grant and the shared selected Drive workspace; bundled loopback model launched with the app's engine arguments (--reasoning off)
limitations: Both installations are signed into the same Google account; the collaborator file was created from the same account. A cross-account share remains unexercised.
The loopback model must be launched with the app's engine arguments: a bare llama-server launch without --reasoning off fails the model's output-format check (500) before any answer is produced.
